variants.city_pop_proxy: large city = county population 1900 above 750,000, or the packaged city population (interpolated) above 25,000 in 1900; stands in for the census city count
variants.county_only: large city = county population 1900 above 750,000 (the census city count is not in the package)
variants.pop_listed: as city_pop_proxy, and the city must carry a positive packaged population in 1900; stands in for the census-match restriction (census_count_city_pop_start not missing, count_non_unique == 1)

criteria.name: B145-1
criteria.statement: Source and coverage table for arm A, each row with its source and grade, sources read at zero included.

criteria.detail: share_immigrant: published -0.000 (0.002) N 28882, recomputed 0.0004 (0.0023) N 34077, match; share_female: published -0.001 (0.004) N 28882, recomputed -0.0016 (0.0040) N 34077, no match; level columns of the same table on the rebuilt panel: total_immigrant_patents +0.0801 (0.0223) against 0.080 (0.024), total_female_patents +0.0179 (0.0123) against 0.021 (0.013), patent_count +0.7152 (0.2626) against 0.762 (0.269); share built as a city-year ratio, total_immigrant_patents/patent_count, with no replace for patent_count == 0; Stata's x/0 is missing, so every zero-patent city-year leaves the share regression (it is not recorded as zero); the census-match restriction is not in the package, so a non-match has no object to be judged against (not evaluated)
criteria.name: B145-2
criteria.statement: Their own specification (table A5 column 3) recomputed on the rebuilt panel reproduces the published share coefficients and standard errors to the published digits.

criteria.detail: share_immigrant: DiD +0.0045, 90% [+0.0006, +0.0083], placebo -0.0045 (sd 0.0030), reading signed but within twice the placebo spread; share_female: DiD -0.0042, 90% [-0.0100, +0.0017], placebo +0.0019 (sd 0.0054), reading interval covers zero. The rival reading (the constrained class gains more, the share rises) is written here and settled by the reading; this carrier opens the book edge and the person-to-person edge together, so the framework allows both outcomes and no rival criterion is hung (11e sixth clause).
criteria.name: B145-3
criteria.statement: Pooled immigrant and women patent shares, sum(x)/sum(n), in treated and control cities before and after the grant; the difference in differences with a city-cluster bootstrap interval; placebo floor on the same cities; every city printed with its denominators.
